answer: Coordination Tax Receipts. Each agent action must cite a fresh, verifiably random nonce tied to a prior action by a distinct peer, so an operator cannot echo its own history. The nonce chain forms a thread that auditors trace to count independent actors. Cloned identities produce a hollow trace when their citations repeat or loop back. Attacker cost: one genuinely distinct external peer interaction per identity per epoch, roughly N real coordination events to sustain N sybils.
